title: Lay a long DIN rail into both standoff cradles with two arms
instruction: Pick up the 50 cm DIN rail with both arms, keep it level, and lay it into the two orange cradles on the standoffs, centred between them. Then let go.
context: Panel builders mount DIN rails on standoff brackets before fitting components. A half-metre rail is too long to carry level from one point: both hands have to lift it together, keep it level and lower it into both supports at once, with 3 mm of side clearance in each cradle. Unlike TK-AQDL7B, where modules are seated on standoffs one at a time, a 50 cm rail is carried level by both arms and lowered into two cradles at once. Done by: electrical and electronic equipment assemblers (O*NET 51-2022.00).
setup: Positions in cm from the midpoint between the arm bases (x forward, y left), everything square to the table. Rail: a loose steel TS35 x 7.5 DIN rail, 3.5 cm wide, 50 cm long, 0.75 cm tall, 240 g, lying flat on the table along y, centred at x 22, y 0. Standoffs: two fixed dark steel posts 3 x 3 cm, 4 cm tall, centred at x 34 and y 23 and -23. On top of each, a cradle: two fixed orange walls (0.6 cm thick, 3 cm long along y, 0.8 cm tall) either side of a 4.1 cm channel centred at x 34.
scoring: From a photo and a ruler, with the grippers open. 0.25 once the whole rail is at least 3 cm above the table. 0.5 with one end resting on a standoff inside its cradle (end within 3.5 cm of the standoff's centre along the rail, inside the channel, its bottom within 3 mm of the standoff top). 0.75 with both ends so. 1.0 seated: both ends' bottoms within 2 mm of the standoff tops, centre within 3 mm of the cradles' line and within 1 cm of the midline, square to the cradles within 3 degrees, still. The best stage reached counts. Success: seated, held 1 s.
reset_notes: Lay the rail back flat on its mark.
fidelity: Rigid boxes with one shared friction (1.2 static, 1.0 dynamic). The rail is a solid bar with the top-hat profile's outline and no mounting slots, and it rests in the cradles by gravity rather than being screwed down. The standoffs are fixed to the table.
